headline: Microsoft fixes Windows activation failures from November update
summary: Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday security updates caused Windows activation and licensing failures, and separately could break printing for documents with complex formatting. Microsoft later shipped emergency out-of-band updates to fix the activation failures, arriving as admins were also handling a separate Exchange outage.
